summary: The candidate adds an all-TileLang raw-FP8 CUDA route, but the exact commit still unconditionally emits zero-width tail operations in sparse_mla_fwd_decode_partial_fp8. GLM-5.3-Flash has qk_rope_head_dim=0, and a direct zero-tail probe fails during TileLang layout inference. A nonzero-tail control compiles and executes on the same gfx950/toolchain, isolating the defect. The candidate is therefore a partial implementation plus test hardening, not a full original-issue fix.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before comparison: 4 failed and 6 passed. The base rejects the candidate's SM90 TileLang/FP8 acceptance and lacks its DCP/layout behavior.
10 unit tests passed; both CUDA numerical tests skipped on ROCm. This validates routing/layout assertions but does not execute the original CUDA kernel contract.

tests.command: ROCM_PATH=/opt/rocm PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python TILELANG_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-abae522faae0/tilelang-cache /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-abae522faae0/venv/bin/python < zero-tail raw-FP8 TileLang probe (on candidate 99ffeba)
tests.what_was_measured: Model-shaped q=[1,32,512], kv=[128,1,512], d_v=512, d_tail=0 reached candidate sparse_mla_fwd_decode_partial_fp8 compilation and failed in TileLang layout inference with divide by zero before launch.

tests.command: ROCM_PATH=/opt/rocm PYTHONPATH=/job/repo/python TILELANG_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-abae522faae0/tilelang-cache /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-abae522faae0/venv/bin/python < nonzero-tail raw-FP8 TileLang control (on candidate 99ffeba)
tests.what_was_measured: With otherwise equivalent inputs and d_tail=64, the kernel compiled for gfx950, launched, synchronized, and returned finite BF16 output.

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 was used. The zero-tail case failed before launch; the independent d_tail=64 control compiled and executed on GPU successfully.
remaining_counterexamples: GLM-5.3-Flash uses qk_rope_head_dim=0. Candidate sparse_mla_fwd_decode_partial_fp8 unconditionally allocates/copies tail buffers and emits a tail GEMM with d_tail=0, producing a TileLang layout-inference divide-by-zero on the prepared compiler.

The candidate's two numerical regression tests use the relevant zero-tail shape but are CUDA-only and skipped in the prepared ROCm review environment, so their passing suite does not cover this failure.

Upstream PR 36904 hardware feedback independently reports the same zero-tail failure for GLM-5.3-Flash and says compile-time d_tail > 0 guards are required; those guards are absent from exact candidate commit 99ffeba.
remaining_limitations: The assigned GPU is AMD gfx950/ROCm 7.2, not NVIDIA H20/SM90, so CUDA code generation and execution were not locally verified.
GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable; no full-model serving, capacity, semantic-accuracy, speculative-decoding, multi-GPU, or multi-node run was performed.
No native rebuild was needed because the candidate changes Python and TileLang DSL sources only, not FlyDSL C++ or another native extension source.
